title: I win 57% of my trades and I'm STILL losing money

scenes.say: Fifty-seven percent of my trades are winners. And I'm still losing money.
Eight hundred fourteen real trades, from my own trading bot. Here's what went wrong.
November eleventh. I sold a put spread and collected fifty-seven dollars. The market ran the wrong way. I lost a hundred and twenty-six.
Two days later, one QQQ put. Bought at a dollar thirty-one. Sold at three seventy-five. Plus two hundred forty-four.
But look at the last month of options. I won sixty-nine percent of the time. My average win, twelve dollars. My average loss, twenty-eight.
So here's the lesson. Your win rate doesn't matter if your losses are bigger than your wins. Cut losers fast. Let winners run.
